h1: Custom Rectangular Candles for Branded Promotions
metaDescription: Order custom rectangular candles for corporate gifts. Scented soy wax in bulk. Perfect for brand recognition. Shop at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Rectangular candles offer a clean, modern silhouette that stands out from standard round tapers. Their flat sides provide a generous canvas for full-color logo imprints or foil stamping, making them ideal for corporate gifts, event favors, and retail displays. Choose from scents like Bamboo Soy or Santal to match your brand's personality. Bulk orders ensure consistent quality and fast turnaround.
heroAltText: Custom rectangular candles in soy wax with branded labels, perfect for corporate gifts and promotional events.
